steps.title: Inspect and measure the prints
steps.action: Check for cracks, warped plates and damaged holes. Try the intended M4 hardware gently. Measure both link centers and both fixed/carrier pivot separations.
steps.measure: Link centers: 110 mm each. Pivot spacing: 40 mm on both plates. Record actual hole fit, printed revision, material and quantities.
steps.evidence: Dimensions and a photo of the measured parts; retain any fit failures.

steps.title: Assemble the passive parallelogram
steps.action: For R01, place 2 mm spacers at both ends of the lower link and 12 mm spacers at both ends of the upper link. Keep both plates behind the links.
steps.measure: Actual spacer and fastener stacks, bolt-end clearance, pivot retention and free motion. Match the printed revision before using this layout.
steps.evidence: Side and end-view photos; fasteners retained without binding.

steps.title: Sweep 15–45° by hand
steps.action: Secure the fixed plate, support the carrier and disconnect the drive. Gently approach 15°, 30° and 45° from both directions; also check intermediate positions.
steps.measure: Axle x/y, closest clearance, rubbing, binding and neutral free play. Do not force a collision.
steps.evidence: Photos at three poses and notes identifying the closest hardware clearances.

steps.title: Check motor and wheel packaging
steps.action: Independently support the received motor at the proposed carrier location with power disconnected. Check shaft, hub, wheel, bearing and cable envelopes across the sweep.
steps.measure: Motor mass and mounting/shaft dimensions; actual wheel and cable clearances. The Ø100 disc represents an envelope only.
steps.evidence: Packaging photos and a list of mount, hub and bearing details still needed.

steps.title: Repeat five hand sweeps
steps.action: After a clear first sweep, repeat slowly five times. Recheck retained hardware and print condition, and approach neutral from both directions.
steps.measure: Cycle count, endpoint repeatability, neutral free play and changes in print condition. No test payload on R01.
steps.evidence: Before/after photos and measured play; keep failures in the journal.

steps.title: Qualify the restrained wheel channel
steps.action: After mount, support and electrical checks, pin the leg and lift the wheel. Verify motor/encoder direction, then follow the bounded wheel-only bench trial.
steps.measure: Speed, sign, response, current, rail voltage and temperature. Verify current limiting, kill and fault behavior.
steps.evidence: Wiring/firmware revision, logs and supported fault checks. Start with the full bench guide.

steps.title: Commission one supported driven leg
steps.action: After servo arrival and bare-servo checks, fit the supported 3:1 transmission. Begin the guide’s 28–32° small-motion trial at 1°/s, with catch support.
steps.measure: Ten small cycles, independently measured angle, error, backlash, current, rail voltage and temperature.
steps.evidence: Servo identification, transmission/neutral mapping, logs and deliberate-rearm fault tests.

steps.title: Qualify loading and duty
steps.action: Use a reviewed structure and load path, captured measured loads and a defined force direction/lever arm. Proceed only after the guide’s unloaded, electrical and fault gates.
steps.measure: Load, deflection, backlash, hold duty, temperature and power-loss behavior. R01 alone has no applied-load qualification.
steps.evidence: Dated load/duty session and measured acceptance evidence; no balance gate is closed by this bench alone.

events.title: R01 passive print kit prepared
events.notes: 110 mm parallel links, 40 mm pivots and separate lateral spacers; geometry mockup only.

events.title: Motor/drivers received · parts printed
events.notes: User report recorded October 2. Total driver count, printed revision/material and received dimensions remain to confirm. No measured test result reported.

events.title: Mechanical test route opened
events.notes: The passive fit checklist is ready. Begin inspection, assembly, hand sweeps and packaging; every measured test result is still open.
